cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Mr. Yang is a true crossover artist, a pioneer who can hop between classical and popular music and bring fresh ideas to fans of both genres. Rather than maintaining an insular focus and simply assuming that an audience for classical music will always exist, he wants to actively create that audience, to persuade and seduce others into enjoying a type of music as passionately as he does. Texas Observer

sections.title: Welcome
body: Grammy Award-winning violinist and vocalist Charles Yang—best known as a member of the genre-defying trio Time for Three—returns to Boston in support of his forthcoming album. Described by The Boston Globe as playing “classical violin with the charisma of a rockstar,” Yang fuses countless musical influences—from Rachmaninoff and Brahms to The Beatles and B.B. King—into one multifaceted musical experience. Full of virtuosity and heart, Yang shares the songs that shaped his journey and musical vision in a moving, deeply original show that celebrates creativity and the limitless possibilities of music.
